  ⇅ qbitctl
  ▸ 1 Queue      2 Search      3 Server      4 Config
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Queue                                  Torrent actions
  /      Filter queue                    s   Start
  o      Sort queue                      p   Pause
  enter  Torrent details                 f   Force start
  space  Mark torrent                    m   Move
  esc    Clear marks                     t   Trackers
  a      Add torrent                     e   Edit focused / marked
                                         x   Remove
                                         ⇧d  Delete files

  Search                                 Dialogs
  /      New search                      tab/⇧tab  Change field
  s      Sort results                    enter     Submit
  f      Filter results                  esc       Cancel
  enter  Add result
  esc    Cancel / clear filter

  Session
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  esc back   ↑/↓ scroll   pgup/pgdn page
